q1.explanationZh: phase 名词“阶段；时期”，a new phase“一个新阶段”。

q2.explanationZh: phenomenon“现象”，复数是 phenomena 或 phenomenons。

q3.explanationZh: philosophy“哲学”，注意 ph 发 /f/，结尾是 -sophy。

q5.explanationZh: photo 是 photograph 的简写，“照片”，复数 photos。

q6.explanationZh: photograph 加 -er 构成 photographer“摄影者”。

q7.explanationZh: photograph 加 -ic 构成形容词 photographic“摄影的”。

q8.explanationZh: photography“摄影术”，注意与 photographer“摄影者”区分。

q9.explanationZh: phrase“短语，词组”，a verb phrase“动词词组”。

q10.explanationZh: physical 形容词“身体的；物理的”，physical and mental health“身心健康”。

q11.explanationZh: physician 指“（内科）医生”，不要和 physicist“物理学家”混淆。

q12.explanationZh: physics 去 s 加 -ist 构成 physicist“物理学家”。

q13.explanationZh: physics“物理”，以 -s 结尾但作单数名词用。

q15.explanationZh: piano“钢琴”，复数 pianos，play the piano“弹钢琴”。

q16.explanationZh: pick 动词“采摘”，pick flowers“摘花”。

q17.explanationZh: picnic 名词“野餐”，也可作动词“去野餐”，过去式 picnicked 要加 k。

q18.explanationZh: picture 名词“图片”，作动词表示“想象”，如 picture life 200 years ago。

q19.explanationZh: pie“馅饼”，an apple pie“苹果馅饼”。

q20.explanationZh: piece“块；片；段”，a piece of music“一段音乐”，注意 ie 的顺序。

q23.explanationZh: pile 名词“堆”，动词“堆积”，a pile of“一堆”。

q24.explanationZh: pill“药丸；药片”，结尾双写 l。

q26.explanationZh: pilot 名词“飞行员”，动词“引航；驾驶”，形容词“试验性的”，如 a pilot study。

q27.explanationZh: pin 名词“别针”，动词“别住”，pin the papers together“把文件别在一起”。

q30.explanationZh: pink 名词“粉红色”，也可作形容词“粉红色的”。

q31.explanationZh: pioneer 名词“先锋；开拓者”，动词“开创”，结尾是 -eer。

q33.explanationZh: pity 名词“同情；遗憾”，What a pity!“真遗憾！”

q35.explanationZh: “动词词组”= a verb phrase，phrase 意为“词组”。

q37.explanationZh: pick up 有“捡起；学会；接人”等多个意思。

q38.explanationZh: take a picture“拍照”，动词用 take。

q39.explanationZh: painting 指着色的画，a mural painting“壁画”。

q40.explanationZh: drawing 指线条画，a chalk drawing“粉笔画”。

q41.explanationZh: apple 以元音音素开头，所以用 an：an apple pie。

q42.explanationZh: a pile of“一堆”，后接可数名词复数 apples。

q43.explanationZh: music 是不可数名词，用 a piece of 表示“一段”。

q44.explanationZh: feel/show pity for sb.“对某人表示同情”，介词用 for。

q45.explanationZh: It is a pity that ...“……真可惜”，it 是形式主语，that 从句是真正的主语。

q46.explanationZh: What a pity (that) ...!“……真是遗憾！”，pity 前要用 a，that 可以省略。

q47.explanationZh: pin 名词“别针”，a diamond pin“钻石别针”。

q48.explanationZh: a piece of 可译作“一片/一张/一段……”，常修饰不可数名词。

q49.explanationZh: answer the phone“接电话”，phone 意为“电话”。

q50.explanationZh: picnic 作不及物动词“去野餐”，叙述过去的事用过去式，picnic 的过去式要加 k：picnicked。

q51.explanationZh: 能开具生病证明的是“医生”，physician 指（内科）医生。

q52.explanationZh: 修饰名词 exhibition 要用形容词，photographic exhibition“摄影展”。

q53.explanationZh: frame this picture“把这幅画装上框”，this 后用单数 picture。

q54.explanationZh: 牛顿发现物理定律，是一位“物理学家”physicist，a famous 后用单数。

q55.explanationZh: pick and choose“挑三拣四”，Don’t 后接动词原形 pick。

q56.explanationZh: the first prize“一等奖”，获胜者因画作获得一等奖。

q57.explanationZh: pine 意为“松树；松木”，pine furniture“松木家具”。

q58.explanationZh: pink 作形容词“粉红色的”，修饰 sky。

q59.sampleAnswer: A photographer recorded the scene on video for posterity,
references: A photographer recorded the scene on video for posterity,

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: photographer“摄影师”作主语；for posterity“为后代”，record ... on video“用摄像机录下”。

q60.sampleAnswer: My hobbies are football, music, photography, and tennis.
references: My hobbies are football, music, photography, and tennis.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: 爱好“摄影”用名词 photography，与 football、music、tennis 并列。

q61.sampleAnswer: Ben went on a trip to the mountains last week and took many photos there.
references: Ben went on a trip to the mountains last week and took many photos there.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “拍照片”= take photos，many 后用复数 photos；last week 用一般过去时。

q62.sampleAnswer: As for parents, nothing can be compared with their children’s physical and mental health.
references: As for parents, nothing can be compared with their children’s physical and mental health.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “身心健康”= physical and mental health；be compared with“与……相比”。

q63.sampleAnswer: The structure of the universe may not be reducible to a problem in physics.
references: The structure of the universe may not be reducible to a problem in physics.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “物理问题”可说 a problem in physics；be reducible to“可简化为”。

q64.sampleAnswer: Her daughter spends most of her free time in playing the piano.
references: Her daughter spends most of her free time in playing the piano.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: 弹钢琴 play the piano，乐器前加 the；spend time (in) doing sth.“花时间做某事”。

q65.sampleAnswer: Children are often told that they mustn’t pick flowers in public gardens.
references: Children are often told that they mustn’t pick flowers in public gardens.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “采花”= pick flowers；“被告知”用被动语态 are told。

q66.sampleAnswer: If it doesn’t rain tomorrow, we will have a picnic in the park.
references: If it doesn’t rain tomorrow, we will have a picnic in the park.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “去野餐”= have a picnic；if 条件句用一般现在时表示将来，主句用 will。

q67.sampleAnswer: There is no need for you to take vitamin pills if you have a balanced diet.
references: There is no need for you to take vitamin pills if you have a balanced diet.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “吃药片”用 take pills；There is no need for sb. to do sth.“某人没有必要做某事”。

q68.sampleAnswer: He feels it a pity that in order to finish the research he has no time to keep his daughter company.
references: He feels it a pity that in order to finish the research he has no time to keep his daughter company.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: feel it a pity that ...“觉得……很遗憾”，it 是形式宾语；keep sb. company“陪伴某人”。

q69.sampleAnswer: It is hard to picture life 200 years ago.
references: It is hard to picture life 200 years ago.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: picture 作动词“想象”，It is hard to do sth.“做某事很难”。
